scope: Three benchmark source images inspected directly; scores assess still key art, not production-ready models or encounter implementation.
hard_gates: Adult cinematic treatment; no mascot/cartoon styling
Distinct principal silhouette and readable focal subject
No visible text, watermark or obvious franchise emblem
No conspicuous anatomical failure at viewing size

strengths: Convincing planted limbs, displaced rubble and shoulder mass give the creature physical weight.
Scouts behind broken masonry establish imminent danger and usable cover.
Single cold overhead opening with restrained jaw heat creates coherent cinematic lighting.
issues: Jaw reads as an ordinary toothed crocodilian jaw around a slab; the defining split interlocking grinding plates are not clearly established.
Three near-side legs are readable, but all six attachments cannot be anatomically verified from this occlusion.
Wet sheen dominates basalt skin and keratin together; material separation is weaker than requested.
Most original identity currently comes from extra legs and furnace setting, while skull remains close to an enlarged crocodile.
images.decision: Usable adult-cinematic benchmark; refine defining grinding-jaw anatomy before treating this as the final identity lock.

strengths: Resolved mature face, plausible hands, bare-foot contact and weighty fabric avoid the previous childish direction.
Three large quartz blades and austere architecture make a coherent restrained silhouette.
Near-monochrome mineral palette offers useful contrast to a beast in darkness.
issues: Scale reads as a giant several times the challenger's height, substantially exceeding the stated 3.2 metres; stair risers reinforce that reading.
Pose is mostly symmetrical and still; the intended forward-loaded duelist stance and one blade's directional pre-attack tell are weak.
Dense garment patterning and wrapped torso dilute the requested severe smoke-grey silk and simple mineral chest mantle.
The requested negative space above one shoulder is crowded by obelisks and architecture.
images.decision: Revise before using as scale/anatomy reference. Either repair to 3.2 metres with both figures on a comparable depth plane or deliberately change the proposed specification; sharpen the imminent-duel action.

strengths: Strong navigable foreground, broken bridge, distant destination and abyss establish exploration stakes.
Filter-reef buttresses visibly overtake older construction, communicating two histories without prose.
Divers, fish and closed shell valve support scale and latent ecological threat.
Luminous cyan and restrained warm polyp clusters deliver mature wonder without mascot imagery.
issues: Some foreground clarity and local amber lighting read as an air-filled cavern; underwater transport is cinematic shorthand rather than physically exact.
Distant architectural repetition risks generic cathedral vocabulary; future companion images should emphasize distinctive tectonic and reef morphology.
Fine foreground detail competes with the bridge at small gallery-card size; use a deliberate mobile crop or full-image presentation.
images.decision: Accept as the luminous-dungeon benchmark. Preserve the full exploration composition in the gallery.

collection_assessment: The three images clear the central adult-treatment correction. They establish physical menace, austere humanoid power and luminous exploration as distinct registers. Remaining quality risk is specification drift hidden by polished rendering: exact body plans, intended scale and encounter tells need stronger enforcement. Do not describe this review as validating rigs, gameplay, or studio-equivalent production readiness.
provenance_note: Images are original generated concept key art according to supplied task context. Visible inspection cannot establish IP clearance or complete generation provenance; provenance therefore receives 4/5 pending asset-manifest verification.
